scripts.dev: tools/with-root-env.sh run 'export WGW_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:9080 && php packages/api/artisan wgw:dev-install && concurrently -k "turbo run typegen:watch dev:app --filter=@wgw/openapi-types --filter=@wgw/apps" "bash packages/api/scripts/dev-php-server.sh"'
scripts.dev:bootstrap: php packages/api/artisan wgw:dev-install && pnpm --filter @wgw/apps run build:dev
scripts.preview: tools/with-root-env.sh run 'export WGW_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:9080 && pnpm run preview:bootstrap && concurrently -k "bash packages/api/scripts/dev-php-server.sh" "turbo run preview --filter=@wgw/apps"'
scripts.preview:bootstrap: composer --working-dir packages/api install --no-interaction --prefer-dist && php packages/api/artisan wgw:dev-install && pnpm --filter @wgw/apps run build
scripts.build: tools/with-root-env.sh run 'turbo run build --filter=@wgw/openapi-types --filter=@wgw/apps && composer --working-dir packages/api prune && node packages/api/scripts/prune-swagger-ui-vendor.mjs && node packages/api/scripts/sync-runtime-api-package.mjs --with-vendor && node packages/apps/scripts/sync-runtime-app-builds.mjs'
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm run ci:quality:api && pnpm run ci:quality:apps
scripts.ci:quality:api: tools/with-root-env.sh run 'turbo run typegen:check --filter=@wgw/openapi-types && composer --working-dir packages/api lint && composer --working-dir packages/api format:check && composer --working-dir packages/api done-gate'
scripts.ci:quality:apps: tools/with-root-env.sh run 'turbo run typegen:check --filter=@wgw/openapi-types && turbo run lint format:check --filter=@wgw/apps' && pnpm run check:agent-docs && pnpm run test:apps-done-gate
scripts.docker:install:up: bash -c 'EF=(); if [ -f docker/install/.env ]; then EF=(--env-file docker/install/.env); else echo "Tip: cp docker/install/.env.example docker/install/.env"; fi; docker compose -f docker/install/docker-compose.yml "${EF[@]}" up -d --build'
scripts.docker:install:down: bash -c 'EF=(); if [ -f docker/install/.env ]; then EF=(--env-file docker/install/.env); else echo "Tip: cp docker/install/.env.example docker/install/.env"; fi; docker compose -f docker/install/docker-compose.yml "${EF[@]}" down'
scripts.docker:install:logs: bash -c 'EF=(); if [ -f docker/install/.env ]; then EF=(--env-file docker/install/.env); else echo "Tip: cp docker/install/.env.example docker/install/.env"; fi; docker compose -f docker/install/docker-compose.yml "${EF[@]}" logs -f'
